_info: Stock (standard) configuration of ONE engine, loaded automatically when this engine is selected and by the button 'Load stock configuration'. File name = engine id. 'chargers': a catalog id (string) or {"profile": {...}, "count": n} for a part that belongs to this engine only. Maps use the shared rpm axis [800,2000,3500,5000,6000,7000] and load axis [0,25,50,75,100] ([loadIdx][rpmIdx]). 'reference' holds a known factory power figure for later calibration.
name: Toyota 4K - stock configuration
generated: ignition and fuel maps derived from the shared base maps: rpm axis stretched to this engine's redline, fuel scaled by displacement per cylinder, ignition for a naturally aspirated engine (low-load row, 0.1 deg retard per % load)

reference.standard: Japanese net rating in PS as published by Toyota (hp and ft·lbf as published in the source quoting Wikipedia)
reference.source: pakwheels.com forum post quoting the Wikipedia 'Toyota K engine' figures: 65 hp at 5600 rpm, 72 ft·lbf (97 N·m) at 3600 rpm; rollaclub.com forum: 60 hp at 5250 rpm for 1980; Toyota Motor Corporation vehicle lineage table, 1.3 KE70 with 4K-U: 72 PS at 5600 rpm (net)
reference.notes: Headline 65 hp and torque values are second-hand quotes; output varied by year and market in these sources (58-74 hp). Toyota's own vehicle lineage table lists 72 PS at 5600 rpm for the KE70 1.3 with 4K-U, which is about 71 hp and does not match the 65 hp headline. The headline is kept unchanged and the discrepancy is unresolved. Bore/stroke 75 x 73 mm are consistent with 1.29 L. Engine file redline 6000 rpm is above the published peak speed.
